proposed_rules.trigger: Identical top nav (rc1c1 '[2x1] Solutions Business Need Work O...') and bottom footer (rc2: signup CTA + collapsed '| |' link row) recur on every captured page.
proposed_rules.decision: Model as global header/footer fragments, excluded from the per-page section/block inventory; footer's collapsed '| |' link row is a fragment authoring concern, not per-page content.
proposed_rules.rationale: Recurs identically across all templates in this migration; not covered by any existing noise/chrome rule (only cookie overlay and announcement bar are addressed).

proposed_rules.trigger: A full-width bg:gradient/bg:color zone directly above the footer with no captured text or child nodes.
proposed_rules.decision: Flag for Phase 2 targeted DOM extraction rather than treating as a pure decorative section background; likely a newsletter/CTA component that failed to render under the minWidth capture.
proposed_rules.rationale: Zone carries a distinct background but zero text, matching the under-rendering symptom already recognized for list zones, but here on non-listing (use-case) templates.

provenance.evidence: C259 rc1c2c2 [bg:gradient] 1280x493 with no child text

notes: Use-case template: hero + intro + 3 gradient content bands + CTA band + FAQ accordion, all before the empty pre-footer band and global chrome.
